patterns.note: Content sections are full-width with generous vertical padding, featuring centered, constrained content blocks that maintain a spacious, airy feel.
Primary headings use an extremely bold, high-contrast serif typeface for a luxurious and editorial aesthetic, sharply contrasted with clean, legible sans-serif body text.

The dominant background is a warm, light off-white, punctuated by distinct content sections that use soft, pastel background colors (e.g., light mint green, light lavender) to visually differentiate them.

Extensive use of horizontal carousels (e.g., for client logos, project showcases, testimonials, and image galleries) to present multiple items within a single section, allowing users to interactively browse content.
Key informational or call-to-action sections are presented in a two-column layout with distinct, soft pastel background colors for each column, creating visual separation and emphasis.

technique_notes: Hero sections feature oversized, high-contrast serif typography for immediate visual impact, set against a light, warm background, often accompanied by a subtle, outlined call-to-action button.

Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections, often with a centered, constrained content area. Some sections use soft, pastel background colors to visually differentiate them and break the page flow.

The site employs interactive horizontal carousels, likely powered by Swiper.js, to display collections of content such as client logos, project cards, and image galleries. These carousels allow users to navigate through items independently of the main page scroll. Sections themselves primarily reveal through standard vertical scrolling without complex scroll-triggered entrance animations.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold serif headings (~4-5x body text) create strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, legible sans-serif body text and uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle; buttons and image cards have a very slight corner radius, but most elements maintain sharp edges.
design_tokens.spacing: airy; the hero section is very spacious, and content sections feature generous vertical and horizontal padding, contributing to an open and luxurious feel.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold and luxurious typographic treatment, particularly the use of an extremely heavy, high-contrast serif font for all primary headings. This, combined with a soft, warm pastel color palette, creates an authoritative yet approachable brand presence that feels more editorial than a typical agency site.
